device.description: 10-bit 200-500 kSPS 2-channel SAR ADC with SPI-compatible serial interface
device.note: adc102s051.pdf (SNAS262H) p.1 Figure 1 pinout, p.2 pin descriptions, p.3 operating ratings, p.5 output coding, p.6 timing specifications, p.7 serial timing diagram, p.17-18 using the ADC102S051 (frame, control register Tables 2-4), p.19 transfer function

registers.name: CTRL
registers.note: internal control register (no address), loaded through DIN; power-up channel IN1

commands.name: Control Register
commands.note: DIN bits 7:0 on the first 8 rising SCLK edges of each 16-clock conversion (Control Register Bits table); selects the channel of the next conversion

pages: p.1 Figure 1 pinout, p.2 pin descriptions, p.3 operating ratings, p.5 output coding, p.6 timing specifications, p.7 serial timing diagram, p.17-18 using the ADC102S051 (frame, control register Tables 2-4), p.19 transfer function (VA 2.7-5.25 V, digital inputs -0.3 V to VA; tEN 30 ns, tACC 30 ns, tDIS 20 ns (CS rise); DOUT: Z3-Z0 zeros, DB9-DB0, two zeros; DIN: DONTC DONTC ADD2 ADD1 ADD0 DONTC x3)
notModeled: analog inputs; the conversion is clocked by SCLK (the result is the 0 V code 0x000 at once)

channel selection is pipelined: the control byte picks the input of the next conversion (ADD1 ADD0: 00 IN1 (default), 01 IN2, 1x not allowed (DOUT indeterminate); ADD2 don't care); the 0 V result is the same on every channel, so only CTRL changes

continuous conversions inside one CS-low frame (each further 16 SCLKs is a new conversion, track mode re-entered after each 16th rising edge): modeled with a stream frame (one control byte per 16 bits) and idle "repeat" for the output frame
SPI mode 3 chosen (DOUT changes on SCLK falling edges, DIN sampled on rising edges); the datasheet allows SCLK high or low at CS fall within tCSU/tCLH (mode 0 works the same)
power-down while CS is high and between conversions (no visible digital effect)
tCSU / tCLH and SCLK frequency limits; frames must contain a multiple of 16 SCLKs
ADD1 = 1 is not allowed (DOUT indeterminate): the model stores it and still outputs the 0 V code
variants: ADC102S021 is the same pinout and protocol at another sample-rate range (separate datasheet); ADC082S/ADC122S (2-ch) and ADC084S/ADC124S (4-ch) are the 8/12-bit parts
